editorial:
Imagine being a regular guy with a heart of gold who decides to take on the biggest, meanest banks in London just to help his neighbors. That is exactly what you get here. You will meet Dave, a self-made millionaire from Burnley who is tired of seeing local businesses get pushed around by greedy bankers. The vibe is super cozy and uplifting, feeling like a warm hug of a movie. It is a classic underdog story where you really root for the little guy to win against the fancy suits who think they are better than everyone else.

The acting is spot on, especially the way they capture that local town spirit. While the plot is pretty predictable, the emotional payoffs make it work. It is a bit slow in the middle, but the win at the end feels great. If you want something that makes you feel good about humanity, you should definitely check this out. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for a crisp look, or if you love owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: After a long fight with the bank of England, Dave finally wins his battle. He successfully gets the first new banking license in over a century. The movie wraps up with Dave opening his community bank, proving that a regular person can change the system. You see the local businesses finally getting the loans they need to grow, and the elitist bankers are left stunned that a working-class man actually beat them at their own game.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves true stories about underdogs winning against the odds.
